description.shortText: A highway with multiple lanes, structured with sections at grade placed above and below ground level for drones to fly. This mobility model keeps drones safe from crashing into each other and other aircraft during mid-flight.

attachments.name: The Cities of the Future Might Have Drone Highways
attachments.description: A futuristic plan for Shenzhen, China proposes self-driving car tunnels and drone-specific highway lanes.

attachments.name: Drone Highway Designed for Shenzhen
attachments.description: Maybe the first drone highway, designed by Tetra Architects & Planners and Avoid Obvious Architects, shows the way ahead?
